Fixed equal areas imply B/A0->1 as both orders grow, then uniform Taylor expansion gives sharp lcm^-2 angular spread and lcm^-4 variance. The 1376 independent finite checks, including convex-hull constructions, all passed; infinite quantifiers follow from proof rather than finite testing.

An arbitrary-orientation closed law is a natural missing invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact dependence on lcm(n,m) establishes a pronounced arithmetic distinction between equal polygon orders (quadratic range decay) and consecutive coprime orders (quartic range decay). Sharp extrema and full uniform-orientation distribution provide useful geometric input for orientational models beyond previously tabulated aligned mixtures; no downstream jamming theorem is asserted.
